title: Segmentos de transporte (Overture Maps)
description: Segmentos de calles, caminos, vías férreas y vías navegables de Overture Maps dentro del partido de Pergamino, referenciados sin copiar los datos.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: A feature ID. This may be an ID associated with the Global Entity Reference System (GERS) if—and-only-if the feature represents an entity that is part of GERS.

table:columns.name: names
table:columns.type: STRUCT("primary" VARCHAR, common MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR), rules STRUCT(variant VARCHAR, "language" VARCHAR, perspectives STRUCT("mode" VARCHAR, countries VARCHAR[]), "value" VARCHAR, "between" DOUBLE[], side VARCHAR)[])
table:columns.description: Properties defining the names of a feature. The struct carries a primary name, optional common names by language, and optional rules. Quoted from the namesContainer definition in the Overture schema.

table:columns.name: subtype
table:columns.description: Broad category of transportation segment.

table:columns.name: class
table:columns.description: Captures the kind of rail segment.

table:columns.name: subclass
table:columns.description: Refines expected usage of the segment, must not overlap.

table:columns.name: subclass_rules
table:columns.description: Set of subclasses scoped along segment

table:columns.name: connectors
table:columns.description: List of connectors which this segment is physically connected to and their relative location. Each connector is a possible routing decision point, meaning it defines a place along the segment in which there is possibility to transition to other segments which share the same connector.

table:columns.name: road_surface
table:columns.description: Physical surface of the road. May either be specified as a single global value for the segment, or as an array of surface rules.

table:columns.name: road_flags
table:columns.description: Set of boolean attributes applicable to roads. May be specified either as a single flag array of flag values, or as an array of flag rules.

table:columns.name: rail_flags
table:columns.description: Set of boolean attributes applicable to railways. May be specified either as a single flag array of flag values, or as an array of flag rules.

table:columns.name: width_rules
table:columns.description: Edge-to-edge width of the road modeled by this segment, in meters. Examples: (1) If this segment models a carriageway without sidewalk, this value represents the edge-to-edge width of the carriageway, inclusive of any shoulder. (2) If this segment models a sidewalk by itself, this value represents the edge-to-edge width of the sidewalk. (3) If this segment models a combined sidewalk and carriageway, this value represents the edge-to-edge width inclusive of sidewalk.

table:columns.name: level_rules
table:columns.description: Defines the Z-order, i.e. stacking order, of the road segment.

table:columns.name: access_restrictions
table:columns.type: STRUCT(access_type VARCHAR, "when" STRUCT(during VARCHAR, heading VARCHAR, "using" VARCHAR[], recognized VARCHAR[], "mode" VARCHAR[], vehicle STRUCT(dimension VARCHAR, comparison VARCHAR, "value" DOUBLE, unit VARCHAR)[]), "between" DOUBLE[])[]
table:columns.description: Rules governing access to this road segment

table:columns.name: speed_limits
table:columns.type: STRUCT(min_speed STRUCT("value" INTEGER, unit VARCHAR), max_speed STRUCT("value" INTEGER, unit VARCHAR), is_max_speed_variable BOOLEAN, "when" STRUCT(during VARCHAR, heading VARCHAR, "using" VARCHAR[], recognized VARCHAR[], "mode" VARCHAR[], vehicle STRUCT(dimension VARCHAR, comparison VARCHAR, "value" DOUBLE, unit VARCHAR)[]), "between" DOUBLE[])[]
table:columns.description: Rules governing speed on this road segment

table:columns.name: prohibited_transitions
table:columns.type: STRUCT("sequence" STRUCT(connector_id VARCHAR, segment_id VARCHAR)[], final_heading VARCHAR, "when" STRUCT(heading VARCHAR, during VARCHAR, "using" VARCHAR[], recognized VARCHAR[], "mode" VARCHAR[], vehicle STRUCT(dimension VARCHAR, comparison VARCHAR, "value" DOUBLE, unit VARCHAR)[]), "between" DOUBLE[])[]
table:columns.description: Rules preventing transitions from this segment to another segment.

table:columns.name: routes
table:columns.type: STRUCT("name" VARCHAR, network VARCHAR, "ref" VARCHAR, symbol VARCHAR, wikidata VARCHAR, "between" DOUBLE[])[]
table:columns.description: Routes this segment belongs to

table:columns.name: destinations
table:columns.type: STRUCT(labels STRUCT("value" VARCHAR, "type" VARCHAR)[], symbols VARCHAR[], from_connector_id VARCHAR, to_segment_id VARCHAR, to_connector_id VARCHAR, "when" STRUCT(heading VARCHAR), final_heading VARCHAR)[]
table:columns.description: Describes objects that can be reached by following a transportation segment in the same way those objects are described on signposts or ground writing that a traveller following the segment would observe in the real world. This allows navigation systems to refer to signs and observable writing that a traveller actually sees.

table:columns.name: sources
table:columns.type: STRUCT(property VARCHAR, dataset VARCHAR, license VARCHAR, record_id VARCHAR, update_time VARCHAR, confidence DOUBLE, "between" DOUBLE[], provider VARCHAR, "resource" VARCHAR, "version" VARCHAR)[]
table:columns.description: The array of source information for the properties of a given feature, with each entry being a source object which lists the property in JSON Pointer notation. All features must have a root level source which is the default source if a specific property's source is not specified.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Segment's geometry which MUST be a LineSting as defined by GeoJSON schema.

table:columns.name: version
table:columns.description: Version number of the feature, incremented in each Overture release where the geometry or attributes of this feature changed.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)

visual.title: Teselas vectoriales de Overture (transportation)
visual.description: PMTiles que publica Overture Maps para todo el mundo. La capa de esta colección es `segment`; el estilo por defecto oculta lo que cae fuera del partido.

recorte.title: Vistas DuckDB del recorte (vista `segmentos`)
recorte.description: Base DuckDB que contiene solo vistas, una por colección de este subcatálogo. Cada vista lee las partes externas con un prefiltro sobre la columna `bbox` y `ST_Intersects` contra el límite oficial del partido. Se abre con `ATTACH ... (READ_ONLY)` después de cargar `spatial` y `httpfs`.

style.title: Por defecto, con máscara del partido
style.description: Las capas del estilo por defecto de overture-portolan sobre las PMTiles de esta publicación, con una máscara que cubre todo lo que queda fuera del partido.

thumbnail.title: Vista previa
thumbnail.description: El recorte dibujado con el estilo por defecto sobre un mapa base, con la máscara aplicada.
